Method of Attack: Exploitation of ProxyShell vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-34473, CVE-2021-34523, CVE-2021-31207) in Microsoft Exchange servers to drop webshells and backdoors, deploy ransomware, steal unencrypted data, and encrypt devices on the network
Initial access via web shells to execute commands and download software
Use of remote access tools (AnyDesk, Atera, Splashtop, Remote Utilities) and Cobalt Strike beacons
Data exfiltration to MEGA file sharing server
Rapid deployment of ransomware targeting individual network shares
Attack Vector: ProxyShell exploit targeting Microsoft Exchange autodiscover service
Indicators of Compromise: Use of email domain @evil.corp in exploit attempts
Presence of web shells, Cobalt Strike beacons, and remote access tools on compromised servers
Command: start C:\x64.exe -m -net -size 10 -nomutex -p \\[computer Active Directory name]\C$
